ssl_verify_certificate.description: Whether to verify SSL/TLS certificates during connections (recommended: true in production).

ftp_passive_mode.description: Use passive FTP mode to traverse firewalls/NAT (recommended: true).

net_timeout.description: Global network timeout (seconds) for idle connections.

ftp_reconnect_retries.description: Maximum number of FTP reconnect retries before giving up.

ftp_passive_limit.description: Max passive FTP ports to reserve (0 = none).

net_socket_buffer.description: Socket buffer size in bytes (0 = system default).

file_charset.description: Default character set for file names and listings (e.g., 'utf-8', 'iso-8859-1').

ftp_preserve_mtime.description: Preserve original modification time during transfers.

ftp_use_mdtm.description: Use MDTM command to determine file modification time.

ftp_use_list_options.description: Options passed to FTP LIST command (e.g., '-a' to show hidden files).

default_alias_cd.description: Default 'cd' command alias (e.g., 'ls -la' to show files on change).

default_mirror_dir.description: Default root directory for mirror commands.

sites.description: List of predefined remote sites with mirrored configurations.

name.description: Unique identifier for the site (used in alias names).

port.description: Server port (e.g., 21 for FTP, 22 for SFTP, 80/443 for HTTP(S)).

user.description: Username for authentication (leave blank for anonymous).

mirror_local_path.description: Local target directory for mirror (relative or absolute).

enabled.description: Whether this site’s mirror alias is active.

max_parallel.description: Maximum parallel files transferred per mirror job.

include_patterns.description: Glob patterns for files to include in mirror (empty = include all).

exclude_patterns.description: Glob patterns for files to exclude (e.g., ['*.log', 'tmp/*']).

transfer_options.description: Extra options for mirror command (e.g., ['-c', '-P', '2'] for continue + parallel).
